title: Portable troopers v206
author: Mixerdust
selftext:
New update  
The game is evolving drastically  
Added Radars  
Better vehicle physics  
Grenade and reload animations  
New missions  
New map is fully playable  
Bugfixes and tweaks to make the game feel as good as possible  
Next up:  
Soldier skills/stats and progression, Combined arms tactics and further tactical AI upgrades, Snow map

Down the road: More mission types, Naval vehicles and combat, Player stats (wounds and moodlets akin to project zomboid), engineer fortification overhaul (barbed wire, mine fields), More specialist units like mortar teams, Weather overhaul (Currently only rain present which causes fog of different intensity depending how long it lasts), Audio overhaul, and once all of those god forsaken things are done i can think about multiplayer, and a standalone desktop engine transfer, right now i am thinking of the following model for the game:  
A free portable version which will just be the base foundation game  
And a paid for version with drastic overhauls

Play the game here or download:  
[Portable Troopers: The Squad Management Voxel War Game](https://mixerdust.itch.io/portable-troopers)  
Or download from here:  
[Indiedb Portable Troopers](https://www.indiedb.com/games/portable-troopers-the-squad-management-voxel-war-game)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Mixerdust please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.

comments.author: Aggravating-Sweet198
comments.body: okay i just tried it and my feedback is, is there a full offline version of the game without internet and the mouse aim and controls are a bit laggy/there is a bit of delay

replies.author: Mixerdust
replies.body: There is, you can download the file and play it offline, its still through the browser, if controls are a bit sluggish just click on the game screen then it will run just fine. SOLUTION: GAME DOES NOT WORK ON FIREFOX, USE OTHER BROWSERS
